title: Kitten holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 40 Q58 55 55 68' stroke='#c8b8ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='28' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='23' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ff9fb2'/>
  <polygon points='66,43 62,47 70,47' fill='#c83a58'/>
  <!-- kitten body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='78' rx='17' ry='14' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='82' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#ffe0a8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='58' r='15' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='30,50 30,36 42,46' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <polygon points='54,50 54,36 42,46' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <polygon points='32,47 32,40 39,46' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <polygon points='52,47 52,40 45,46' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='57' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#3a2a6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='57' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#3a2a6b'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='56' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <polygon points='42,62 40,64 44,64' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <path d='M42 64 Q39 67 37 65 M42 64 Q45 67 47 65' stroke='#c86a2a' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='28' y1='60' x2='18' y2='58' stroke='#ffe0a8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='28' y1='64' x2='18' y2='66' stroke='#ffe0a8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='60' x2='66' y2='58' stroke='#ffe0a8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='64' x2='66' y2='66' stroke='#ffe0a8' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- front paws reaching to string -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='66' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#ffe0a8'/>
  <!-- back paws -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='90' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffe0a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='90' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffe0a8'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M30 84 Q18 80 20 70' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
